qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Procurement scale and fleet purchasing power fail to provide pricing power; corporate leasing contracts are competitively bid with severe residual-value exposure on second-hand vehicle dispositions (exacerbated by EV depreciation volatility), holding ROIC well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power). Ayvens (formed from ALD Automotive and LeasePlan) is a capital-heavy vehicle fleet lessor with bank-like economics and low single-digit GAAP ROIC, well below the 12% hurdle. Corporate fleet tenders are fiercely competitive and margins are highly exposed to second-hand vehicle residual value depreciation, especially amidst volatile EV resale pricing.
qualitative.evidence: Ayvens operates as a specialized vehicle financing and fleet management lessor backed by Société Générale. The business model requires massive debt funding of vehicle assets, generating structural single-digit ROIC on invested capital. Second-hand car market normalization and sharp EV depreciation compress remarketing margins and expose residual value risk.
